parts.label: (a)
parts.stem: DCPIP is an indicator and can be used to determine the rate of respiration of organisms such as yeast.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: State the category of indicators to which DCPIP belongs.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Describe the colour change that occurs in DCPIP during experiments to determine the rate of respiration.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem:
An investigation was carried out to determine the effect of temperature on the rate of respiration of yeast.

• A suspension of yeast cells was added to a test-tube containing glucose solution.
• A further four test-tubes were set up in the same way.
• One test-tube was placed in a water-bath at $10^\circ\text{C}$ for 5 minutes.
• DCPIP was added to the test-tube and the time taken for the DCPIP to change colour was measured.
• The experiment was repeated using the other test-tubes at $20^\circ\text{C}$, $30^\circ\text{C}$, $40^\circ\text{C}$ and $50^\circ\text{C}$.

The results are shown in Fig. 6.1.
{{figure:figure_6_1.png}}
